source.snippet: I've been exploring tools like n8n and Make to automate tasks such as outreach, finding leads, and managing spreadsheets. The problem is that most of these tools require monthly subscriptions. I also came across other AI automation tools, but their pricing is a bit high for me right now. Since I already have access to Gemini Pro and its task features for free, I'm wondering if I can use it for similar work.

problem_statement: Freelancers and small agency operators need affordable AI-powered automation for outreach, lead generation, and spreadsheet management, but existing tools like n8n and Make carry monthly subscription costs that feel prohibitive at their revenue scale.
target_segment: Solo freelancers and small agency operators (1-5 person shops) doing client outreach and lead gen
notes: Poster is actively paying for or evaluating n8n/Make (competing paid products), confirming budget awareness. Pain is subscription cost relative to revenue, not lack of willingness to pay. Opportunity: a usage-based or one-time-fee AI automation layer targeting freelancers who already know what they want to automate but can't justify per-seat SaaS pricing. Single signal; needs corroboration.
